output.scope_note: The paper is about the argyrodite solid electrolyte Li6PS5Cl in all-solid-state Li metal batteries and reports one measured ionic conductivity value (2 to 2.5 mS/cm by EIS).

records.evidence_quote: The obtained electrolyte pellet, with a thickness of ~1 mm, has an ionic conductivity measured between 2 and 2.5 mS/cm by Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS).
records.notes: Reported as a range (2 to 2.5 mS/cm), not a single value; the value is recorded as written. Measurement temperature is not stated (presumably room temperature, but not given, so left null). Material is commercial Li6PS5Cl from NEI Corporation, cold-pressed at 370 MPa, with no sintering. Relative density 82.1% (Table S2 average) was not attached because it is a separate table of four pellets, not stated directly for this conductivity measurement.
